job.purpose: M5 re-route (reroute_batch.py) of closed el1011-collp2-966562e4c-tc-a (dsfd_coll_p2_ep, RTL 966562e4c, snapshot of 4 drifted files): same RTL, outline 64.8x302.4, pin faces from the closed view; ref_tile layer cap M5 (signals + PG <= M5, pins M4/M5, parent strap M6). Orig owner Claude:el1011-ds-wfc

benches.name: pass_p2_s1
benches.cmd:
B={RUN}/bsrc_m5_0; rm -rf $B && mkdir -p $B && for d in *; do ln -s $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && for d in $(cd physical/ref_tile/dsfd_coll_p2_ep_m5/src && ls -d */ | tr -d /); do rm -f $B/$d; cp -a $PWD/$d $B/$d; done && cp -a physical/ref_tile/dsfd_coll_p2_ep_m5/src/. $B/ && cd $B && { python3 tools/mtp_fixlat_gate.py one p2_s1 --out {RUN}/bench
}
benches.note: [m5rr: run on the 966562e4c snapshot overlay of physical/ref_tile/dsfd_coll_p2_ep_m5/src]
